evidence.title: Context-Aware Cluster Decoding: Semantic Anchor-Driven Coherence in dMLLMs

summary: Researchers introduce Context-Aware Cluster Decoding, a semantic anchor-driven method to improve coherence in diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs). The approach aims to refine contextual understanding in AI-generated outputs.
title: New AI Technique Enhances Coherence in Diffusion-Based Multimodal Models
